transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I guess... well, I got a bit worked up in a staff meeting. I started acting out this whole fall-prevention drill. Just moving chairs around, waving my arms... and I just, I couldn't seem to stop doing it. Even when folks told me to sit down. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Before it started, did you feel an urge or tension that you had to relieve, or was it something you were doing on purpose?
I don't know... I wasn't really feeling tense, exactly. I just... I was just doing it. It wasn't like I planned it out or anything. It just happened.
Right before you started doing that, did you feel a sudden urge to move?
I mean... no. Not really. I didn't feel anything like that. It just kind of started. I don't really know how else to explain it.
Did these kinds of repetitive movements or actions start when you were a child?
No... I don't think so. I never really did anything like that back then.
Were you aware of what was happening during the episode?
I don't really know. I guess... I mean, I wasn't really paying attention to it. It's hard to say.
When it was happening, did you feel like you were watching yourself do it from the outside, almost as if it wasn’t really you?
No... I don't think so. I was just... I don't know, I was just there. I didn't feel like I was outside myself or anything.
During the episode, did you have any gaps in memory for what you did?
I don't think so. I mean, I remember being there. I just... I don't know, I don't think I forgot anything.
During the episode, were you able to respond to people around you?

Not really. I mean... like at that staff meeting. I got kinda worked up and... started acting out this whole fall-prevention drill. Just moving chairs around and waving my arms. Folks kept telling me to sit down, but... I couldn't seem to stop. So, I guess I wasn't really answering them.
During the episode, did you lose consciousness or black out?
No... I don't think so. I was awake the whole time. Just... couldn't stop what I was doing.
Do you remember feeling confused or disoriented right after the episode ended?
No... I don't think so. I just kinda... stopped. I knew where I was and everything, so... no, not confused.
Right before the episode starts, do you feel an urge, pressure, or buildup that you have to let out?
No... not really. I don't feel any pressure or anything like that. It just... happens, I guess.
Does this kind of episode happen in other settings too, or only in staff meetings?
I don't know... I mean, I guess it's mostly just at work. I haven't really noticed it anywhere else.
When these episodes happen at work, are you doing the behavior on purpose?
No, I... I don't think so. I mean, I'm not trying to do it. It just... I don't know, it just happens.
At the moment it starts, do you feel like you are choosing to do it on purpose?
No... like I said, I'm not... I don't decide to do it. It's not a choice I'm making. It just... starts.
When it starts, can you stop yourself if you try?

I... no. Like that time in the staff meeting... I got all worked up and just started acting out this whole fall-prevention drill. Moving chairs around, waving my arms. People were telling me to sit down, but... I couldn't seem to stop.
After the episode ends, do you feel confused or disoriented?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I know where I am and everything. It just... stops.
When these episodes happen, do you ever feel like you are doing it on purpose to get attention or to affect the situation?
No... I don't... I don't want people looking at me. I'm not trying to do that. It just... no.
Do these episodes ever happen when you’re trying to avoid something or get something you want?
No. I don't... I don't use it to get out of things. It's not like that.
Do these episodes usually happen when you’re under a lot of stress?
I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't noticed if it's from stress or not. They just happen.
Do you ever make any sounds, like grunting, throat-clearing, or words, during these episodes?
No... I don't think so. I haven't noticed making any noises.
